text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute had a great run in her debut 
race. However, to bring hope to those in 
the hospital and beyond, she wants to 
compete in races that draw even more 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reaching that pinnacle on dirt is no easy 
feat. That is precisely why she decided to 
run in many races and build up her 
strength.
